pdf_outline: Checklist: residency (6 mo TX + 90 days county) -> agree terms -> Original Petition -> e-file + $350/$365 or Statement of Inability -> Waiver of Service (after filing, notarized) or citation -> answer deadline (TRCP 99) -> Final Decree -> 60-day minimum -> prove-up -> certified copies -> QDRO -> 31st day remarriage
